text:
Frank Nazar is 22, fast, and suddenly a goal scorer. He has 8 goals in 18 games, five of them in his last five games, including two in the comeback win over Buffalo on November 12 that he summed up as "We worked hard and we earned it." He's playing 17.6 minutes a night with 4 power-play points, and his speed bursts sit in the 90th percentile by NHL EDGE.

Two kinds of luck are pulling against each other. His own finishing is hot: 23.5% shooting on 5.59 expected goals, well above the 13.3% league norm. Meanwhile his teammates have been ice cold with him out there, scoring 10.7 fewer goals than their chances deserve, which is why he has only 2 assists.

The process underneath is good. Chicago has been 7.83 points better in shot share at five on five with him on than without, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 62% of his entries last season. By our numbers the goals should slow and the assists pick up; the player in between looks real.
headline: Frank Nazar is finishing everything
